name: Darda
overview: Darda was a male figure in the Old Testament, identified as the son of Zerah. His exact tribe and additional background details are not recorded in Scripture. He is noted primarily for his wisdom, which was surpassed by King Solomon.
namesAndTitles: The name Darda appears in biblical texts without a given meaning or divine origin. An alternate form, Dara, is also used, but neither name has a specified Hebrew or Greek meaning in the Scriptures.
familyAndRelationships: Darda is explicitly identified as the son of Zerah. Beyond this paternal relationship, Scripture does not provide further family connections or lineage details for him.
scriptureSignificance: Darda is recognized in the biblical record as a man of great wisdom, serving as a benchmark to highlight Solomon's superior wisdom. His mention underscores the high regard for wisdom in the biblical narrative and situates Solomon's wisdom within a tradition of notable wise men.
